
=================================================================
#60 Stone Lady  (태초)  [FLASHBACK EPISODE]
Arc: The Fall of Euija · place: halla · tone: island folklore
Logline: Sanbangduk came down out of the rock to love a poor man. The island remembers how that went.
=================================================================
[0] Yuri Dora: Today’s is not a kind one.
[1] Gyebek: That is acceptable.
[2] ¶ A year has gone. He still walks to the shore every dawn and looks at the sea, the same way, for the same count. Five hundred and ninety-six.
[3] Yuri Dora: You looked at the sea again.
[4] Gyebek: Every morning.
[5] Yuri Dora: Then you get the one about looking back.
[6] ¶ There is the serpent in the cave at Gimnyeong that took a girl a year until a young magistrate went in and killed it, and was told on the way out not to look back, and looked back.
[7] Gyebek: Why did he look back.
[8] Yuri Dora: To check that he had won.
[9] Gyebek: I will not look back.
[10] Yuri Dora: You look back every morning, Turtle. At the sea.
[11] Gyebek: That is not back. / That is Sabi.
[12] ── SCENE: Sanbangdeok ──
[13] ¶ There is **Sanbangduk**, who came down out of the rock to love a poor man.
[14] [CARD Sanbangduk: A goddess who stepped out of the Sanbang cliff to see the world. The world noticed.]
[15] Sanbangduk: I came out of the rock… / and when I hold your hand I don’t feel like stone.
[16] The Husband: Then don’t let go. / Whatever the official says.
[17] ¶ Then an official on a tax round sees her at the spring.
[18] The Official: A woman out of the rock belongs to the government. / Like the rock.
[19] The Husband: She belongs to nobody. She picked a hut.
[20] ¶ Poor men always owe something somewhere, and the official finds it. Then the official has the husband killed to take her.
[21] Sanbangduk: You wanted me because I wasn’t stone. / Look again.
[22] ¶ She walks back into the cliff. The spring inside it has not stopped since.
[23] Gyebek: She went back into the rock. / …The rock did not lie to her.
[24] Gyebek: Do all the stories on this island end badly.
[25] Yuri Dora: No. They all end as **stone**. / That’s not the same as badly. Stone stays.
[26] ── SCENE: Gameunjang ──
[27] ¶ Told at a well, while he is fixing the rope.
[28] Gyebek: The men Baekje sends here. / Were any of them right.
[29] Yuri Dora: Right about what?
[30] Gyebek: Anything.
[31] Yuri Dora: Ha. Here’s a girl who was right about one thing. It went badly for her family.
[32] Yuri Dora: A rich man had three daughters. He asked them whose luck they lived on.
[33] Yuri Dora: The elder two said his. The youngest said her own navel-string. / So she was thrown out.
[34] ❝QUOTE (Samgong Bonpuri (삼공본풀이) recited by Jeong Tae-jin (정태진), recorded by Gang Jeong-sik, Gang So-jeon and Song Jeong-hui, 2011 — Sanggari, Aewol-eup (Hanguk Gubimunhak Daegye, rev. ed.)): “By whose grace did you come into the world?” “First, heaven’s. Second, earth’s. Third, Father’s. Fourth, Mother’s — but really, the line drawn under Mother’s navel.”❞
[35] Gyebek: If she had lied she could have stayed.
[36] Yuri Dora: …Yes. She could have.
[37] ¶ She walked until she found three brothers digging yams and married the youngest, the only one who greeted her. In the spoil he had been throwing away as stones, she found gold.
[38] ¶ Her parents lost everything and went blind. Years later she held a beggars’ feast that lasted three days, and served two old blind beggars herself, and said her name, and their eyes opened.
[39] Gyebek: …So the child they threw away was the luck.
[40] Yuri Dora: No. The luck was always hers. / It was the ones who threw her out who went blind.
[41] ¶ He does not answer that one. He finishes the rope, and tests it eleven times.
[42] ¶ **Heaven sends for a man to keep its flower field. He leaves his pregnant wife to wait. He forgets to say how long…!**
